name: Marcus T.
text: Finally someone talking about organic conversion optimization instead of just throwing money at ads. We implemented the checkout optimization tips last month and saw a 3% lift. Small wins add up!

name: Sarah K.
text: Question: does the product page layout advice apply to Shopify Plus stores or just standard plans? Our site does 6 figures monthly so not sure if this scales.

name: James H.
text: The email capture strategy is solid but I'd caution against being too aggressive with popups. We actually tanked our conversion when we added exit-intent popups last year.
